author: PokerFace
body:
Hey guys,

I'm in the works of creating a 1v1 spleef map. I just want to hear some feedback regarding the map and the concept of 1v1 spleef itself. I'm planning on just calling the map "Arena".
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/aWDhc
You can view it on {tag=f866f3863d9d493c8de887b493cab8be} build server if you like, just do /mvtp pokerspleef

Thanks!
